summary: Backend-only verification of Feb 2026 delivery branded-stock scoping bug fixes. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_322_delivery_branded_scoping.py (10 pytest cases, all PASSING) covering: (1) /api/distributor/stock-transfers/location-stock account_id filter — no account returns all rows, owner account sees branded+generic, DIFFERENT account excludes branded (200 bottles filtered) while generic remains; aggregate `stock` sum is correspondingly reduced; (2) /api/distributor/stock-transfers/batches-available with the same three account_id scenarios; branded batch hidden from foreign account; (3) Defensive complete_delivery guard — seeded a synthetic 'confirmed' delivery pointing at a phantom branded child_sku_id with no factory_warehouse_stock row; POST /complete returns HTTP 400 with descriptive 'branded/stock' detail, delivery status reverts to 'confirmed', delivered_at & delivered_by cleared, stock_deduction_error field populated; (4) Regression sanity — omitting account_id preserves legacy shape ({stock, stock_by_child, is_factory}). Also re-ran iteration_321 phase-3 pytest (11/11 still passing) — branded classification create/complete/reverse, wrong-account 400, wrong-parent 400, generic-only regression all intact. Combined 21/21 tests green. Tenant state fully cleaned (no TEST_ residue; seed 200+200 bottles at Default master intact).
critical_code_review_comments: distributor_stock_transfers.py filter is applied in-Python after the DB fetch — fine at current row counts, but could be pushed into the Mongo query (`child_sku_id: {$in: allowed_or_None}`) if a tenant ever grows to 10k+ rows per warehouse.

In complete_delivery (distributors.py L5847-5881), the revert path clears delivered_at/delivered_by only for the FIRST offending item and then raises — subsequent items are not processed. This is the correct fail-fast behaviour, but note the delivery status was already flipped to 'complete' at L5779 before the loop; the revert query correctly resets it, so no data-integrity issue, just a small inefficiency (a double write). Consider deferring the status flip until AFTER all items succeed to avoid the write-then-revert round-trip.

The batches-available account_id filter loads all child_skus for the parent SKU (up to 2000). For SKUs with many child SKUs this is fine, but a projected index on (tenant_id, parent_sku_id, customer_account_id) would keep it fast.
distributors.py is now 10301 lines — well past the 700-line guideline. Extract delivery/reservation/completion logic into a dedicated service module.

The `stock_deduction_error` field is a free-text string — no schema/enum. Consider a structured shape ({code, item_id, sku_id, child_sku_id, message}) so the FE can render a targeted UI cue rather than parsing the sentence.
